extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: Unlimited/indefinite storage for free accounts; no published total-byte cap. Third-party trackers consistently report 'unlimited storage, permanent hosting'.
extras.limits_verbatim: 32 MB/image via API (binary, base64, or image URL). Optional 'expiration' 60-15,552,000 s. The anonymous upload endpoint needs a session token, so automation must use the API-key path.
extras.egress_verbatim: Free, unmetered direct links on i.ibb.co. No bandwidth quota published, no hotlink restriction.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited free accounts, each with its own API key. Each upload returns a delete_url, so per-file turnover is scriptable.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Official API v1 at api.imgbb.com — POST multipart or GET with base64/URL, single 'key' param. ShareX, PicGo and Flameshot all ship ImgBB destinations.
extras.agent_focus: image hosts and photo platforms as bulk binary storage: free byte ceilings are high or unlimited because photos are the product, but most re-encode. Crux = which hosts return the original bytes, verified by HEAD/hash, not by marketing copy.
